dealbreakers: Spanish La Rochefoucauld item: "Es la respuesta, con siglos de ventaja, a «ojos que no ven, corazón que no siente»" is false. The Spanish proverb is attested by the early 17th century (variant "corazón que no quiebra"; refranero tradition up to Correas 1627), so a maxim from 1665 cannot have come centuries ahead of it. It is also a claim the English post does not make.
